name: Karnataka Free Student Bus Pass (2026-27)
price_note: Government pays the pass fee, a Rs 100 processing fee per pass and Rs 50 accident-relief contribution. Students applying at a Bangalore One / Karnataka One counter may still be charged a Rs 30 service charge for data entry.
validity_note: Academic-year pass: approx. Jun 2026 - Mar 2027 for school/PUC, Jul 2026 - Jun 2027 for degree/professional, Aug 2026 - Jul 2027 for technical/medical. Validity follows the existing category rules.
geographic_scope: All non-AC services of the four state RTCs inside Karnataka, subject to the existing distance limits (KSRTC norm: up to 60 km one-way between residence and institution).
eligibility: Any regular student enrolled in a recognised school, PU college, degree, diploma, ITI, professional, medical, evening or PhD course in Karnataka. Also extended to Karnataka-domicile students studying in neighbouring states and to students from border districts.
documents_required: Institution-signed student bus pass application form (downloaded from Seva Sindhu)
Fee receipt for the current academic year
Passport-size photograph (live photo is captured at the counter when the smart card is printed)
Mobile number registered on Seva Sindhu
Caste certificate with RD number (SC/ST applicants only)
where_to_apply: Online on the Seva Sindhu / e-District portal (sevaone.karnataka.gov.in) from 29 May 2026. Apply free online; Rs 30 service charge at Bangalore One / Karnataka One / Grama One centres. Collect the smart card in person at the designated counter.
notes: State Transport Department order effective 12 June 2026. Covers non-AC BMTC and KSRTC ordinary services only; it does NOT cover BMTC AC/Vajra, Vayu Vajra or luxury KSRTC classes. Girl students already travel free under Shakti and do not need this pass. Existing pass holders for 2026-27 are being refunded via Seva Sindhu.

name: Shakti Scheme — free travel for women
price_note: No ticket and no pass purchase; show a Karnataka ID or the Shakti smart card.
validity_note: Ongoing scheme, in force since 11 June 2023.
geographic_scope: Non-premium state buses (BMTC ordinary and KSRTC ordinary/express) within Karnataka. Not valid on AC, Vajra, Vayu Vajra, Airavat, Ambari, Rajahamsa or other luxury classes; not valid for the portion of an interstate journey that leaves Karnataka.
eligibility: Women and transgender residents of Karnataka (photo ID / domicile proof).
documents_required: Aadhaar or any Karnataka residence/identity proof
Shakti smart card where already issued
where_to_apply: No application needed for most travellers — just carry ID. The Shakti smart card is issued through the Seva Sindhu portal.
notes: For a woman Karnataka resident on non-AC buses this dominates every paid pass. The agent must check this before recommending any paid product.

name: BMTC Student Monthly Pass — AC (Vajra)
price_note: Monthly with effect from 9 January 2025 (up from Rs 1,200). The free student pass does not cover AC services, so this remains a paid product.
geographic_scope: BMTC network including AC Vajra services, but NOT Vayu Vajra airport services.
eligibility: Enrolled student with valid institution ID / bonafide certificate and fee receipt. Karnataka residence required for the concessional student category.
documents_required: Bonafide certificate or current-year fee receipt
where_to_apply: BMTC pass counters at major bus stations (Majestic/KBS, Banashankari TTMC, Shivajinagar, Electronic City, Anekal etc.) or the Namma BMTC app; applications via Seva Sindhu for student categories.
notes: Worth it only if the student regularly uses AC routes; the free pass already covers all non-AC travel. Verify the current rate on the Namma BMTC app, rates were last revised in January 2025.

name: BMTC Ordinary Monthly Pass (non-AC)
price_note: Rs 1,200 per calendar month with effect from 9 January 2025 (up from Rs 1,050). A Rs 1,500 'ordinary extension' monthly pass exists for newly extended routes beyond 40 km.
geographic_scope: Unlimited travel on all non-AC BMTC services within the network (toll-road tolls extra).
eligibility: Any commuter; ID proof required at the counter.
documents_required: Photo ID proof (Aadhaar / driving licence / student ID)
where_to_apply: BMTC pass counters at major bus stations, or online via the Namma BMTC app / mybmtc.karnataka.gov.in.
notes: The benchmark paid pass for non-students. Daily pass Rs 80, weekly Rs 350 (same revision).

name: BMTC Vajra AC Monthly Pass
price_note: Rs 2,000 per calendar month with effect from 9 January 2025 (up from Rs 1,800). Vayu Vajra airport services excluded.
geographic_scope: BMTC Vajra AC services except Vayu Vajra (airport).
where_to_apply: BMTC pass counters / Namma BMTC app.
notes: Only worth it above roughly 50 AC rides a month.

name: BMTC Vayu Vajra Gold Monthly Pass (airport)
price_note: Rs 4,000 per calendar month with effect from 9 January 2025 (up from Rs 3,755). Includes toll + GST components.
geographic_scope: All BMTC services including Vayu Vajra airport routes (except Bangalore Rounds and special services).
where_to_apply: BMTC pass counters / Namma BMTC app.
notes: Only relevant for frequent airport travellers; a Vayu Vajra single ticket is usually cheaper for occasional trips.

name: KSRTC Student Bus Pass (now covered by the free scheme)
price_note: Free for 2026-27 under the state free-pass order. Pre-scheme rates (for reference): college/diploma Rs 1,050 for 10 months, professional courses Rs 1,550, high-school boys Rs 750, high-school girls Rs 550.
validity_note: 10 months (12 for ITI), aligned to the academic year.
geographic_scope: KSRTC ordinary services on the declared home-to-institution route, up to 60 km one-way under existing norms.
eligibility: Karnataka-domicile student commuting daily on a defined KSRTC route. Interstate and border-area students apply under separate concessional categories.
documents_required: Distance declaration if the institution is more than 40 km away
where_to_apply: Seva Sindhu portal (free) or Karnataka One / Grama One / Bangalore One counters (Rs 30 service charge). Collect the pass at the chosen KSRTC counter.
notes: This is the pass that matters for the Harohalli / Kanakapura corridor, because that leg runs beyond the BMTC city network. It does not cover KSRTC luxury classes (Airavat, Ambari, Rajahamsa).

name: KSRTC Monthly Season Ticket (Sarige / ordinary)
price_note: Priced per corridor by the issuing depot; there is no single published tariff, and no accessible open dataset of corridor prices.
geographic_scope: Travel between two named places (usually up to 11 fare stages) on KSRTC ordinary services.
eligibility: Any daily commuter on a fixed corridor; photo identity card issued by KSRTC (Rs 50).
documents_required: Completed pass application at the depot
where_to_apply: Nearest KSRTC depot / bus station counter.
notes: KSRTC prices season tickets corridor-by-corridor at the depot. The agent must not quote a number for this pass; it should send the student to the depot with the corridor details.
